raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: geomodels
  version: "1.0.1"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 41869b79eb26151a8b7fa3ed8f604312f338a16ef0d9f8248639a0e691967914

build:
  number: 2
  skip: match(python, "<3.11")
  script:
    env:
      GEOMODELS_IGNORE_BUNDLED_LIBS: true
      GEOMODELS_GEOGRAPHICLIB_NAME: ${{ "GeographicLib-i" if win else "GeographicLib" }}
    content: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - geomodels-cli = geomodels.cli:main

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - python
    - cython
    - geographiclib-cpp >=2.0
    - numpy
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - argcomplete
    - geographiclib-cpp >=2.0
    - numpy
    - python
    - tqdm

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - geomodels
      pip_check: true
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - pytest
    script:
      - geomodels-cli --help
      - geomodels-cli install-data -d data recommended
      - python -m geomodels info
      - env GEOGRAPHICLIB_DATA=./data python -m pytest tests

about:
  summary: Python package for Earth data models management
  description: |
    GeoModels provides tools for the management of Earth models like
    geoids, gravity models, and magnetic field models.
    It also provides some utility function to download and install
    support data to that are necessary for Earth models computation.
    It is basically a Cython_ wrapper for part of the the GeographicLib
    C++ library.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/avalentino/geomodels
  repository: https://github.com/avalentino/geomodels
  documentation: https://geomodels.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - avalentino
